# webtables/deref

> Dereference: `*p`, a word or (for `u8`) a byte.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/deref.pkg) · translates [std/deref](../std/deref.md)

The `addr` section is the pointer itself, for assignment.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when self size 1`

```nasm
(i64.load8_u (i32.wrap_i64
{p}
))
```

### `emit`

```nasm
(i64.load (i32.wrap_i64
{p}
))
```

### `emit addr`

```nasm
{p}
```
